**Established:** 60 cm reflector (2017), 20 cm refractor for outreach. 195 useful nights/year average; 168 in 2024 (wet autumn). 400 GB/month, transferred nightly to Marseille, 40 min.

**Decided:** No runs during outreach evenings (2023 incident). Raw frames never deleted, compressed after two years. Acquisition software changes need a test night.

**Failed/fixed:** 2023 dome motor seized, telescope hit wall, counterweight rod bent; rod replaced, limit switch added. Feb 2025: 1.2 s timestamp offset lost three weeks of photometry; now GPS-checked each session. March 2025 camera replaced after two cooling failures; 30% lower read noise.

**Planned:** Firmware update, needs one offline night.

**Open:** Spanish collaboration scheduling tool unevaluated; network capacity for simultaneous transfers unknown.
